businesses.business: factual streaming video and content licensing

offering_description.value: Operates a subscription streaming service of documentary and factual entertainment series and films, sold to consumers directly and through distribution partners. It also licenses its content library to third parties, including media and AI companies. Content is produced in-house, commissioned or acquired.

primary_products.value: subscription streaming video service; licensed documentary content library

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual subscribers to documentary streaming; B2B: media companies, platforms, and AI firms licensing content, bundled distribution partners

end_markets.value: media and entertainment; streaming video; education; AI training data

revenue_model.value: subscription: monthly and annual streaming subscriptions, direct and via partners; licensing or royalties: licensing of content library to third parties

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: operates streaming app and platform serving subscribers; brand owner: commissions, produces and acquires content, licensed to media buyers

geography_served.value: global: Subscribers and licensees worldwide, with significant US base

specialization.value: related lines: documentary subscription streaming and content licensing

distribution_channels.value: online: own website and apps direct to subscribers; partners / resellers: bundles with pay-TV, telecom and streaming platforms; direct sales: content licensing deals with media and technology companies

regulatory_exposure.value: low: general media, consumer privacy and copyright rules apply
